summary: This directory centralizes low-level utility functions for converting between various binary and string data types. It ensures consistent and reliable transformations between Buffers, ArrayBuffers, and strings across the codebase.
responsibilities: Converting between different binary data representations
relationships: Transformation functions enable the conversion between raw byte representations and high-level string formats.
Data type conversions are essential for bridge-building between environment-specific binary buffers and standard data types.
designDecisions: Consolidate binary conversion utilities in a shared location
Abstract environment-specific buffer handling to ensure cross-platform compatibility
